instruction: Compute (3^2026 + 7^2027) modulo 100000, using non-negative remainders. Do not try to build the full numbers; use modular exponentiation with the bash tool (python3 -c). Work only inside the current directory. When you are done, write ONLY the final answer to the file answer.txt in the current directory (for example with bash: echo 42 > answer.txt).
